kind: functional regression gate (not a recall eval)
assertion: doctor(after).score > doctor(before).score AND zero new finding rule-classes
target: examples/convex-nextjs (Convex Next.js starter), baseline 94/100, 5 convex findings
findings: The convex-doctor-fix loop verifiably raises a real project's doctor score (94->98) with zero new findings, both via a deterministic golden-fix gate and via 3/3 independent LLM fixer runs.
Agents applied the AUTO fixes (auth checks, public->internal refs) and correctly LEFT the PROPOSE-class sequential-ctx-run unfixed every time — the apply-policy works behaviourally.
gate.sh is a $0, ~3s, CI-able regression gate; the LLM loop (~$0.20/run Sonnet) is what produces the fix. Self-reports were not trusted — every result was re-scanned independently.
